name: Microsoft FASTER
tagline: Microsoft Research's larger-than-memory concurrent KV store and log; superseded by Garnet's Tsavorite.
description: FASTER is a Microsoft Research library offering FASTER KV, a concurrent key-value store and cache for point lookups and heavy in-place updates, and FASTER Log, a high-throughput persistent log. Its hybrid log spans memory and SSD or cloud storage, so datasets can exceed RAM, and non-blocking checkpoints give consistent recovery; it was used inside Azure services and Durable Functions' Netherite backend. Microsoft now marks the repository as no longer actively maintained and directs users to Garnet, whose Tsavorite storage engine is FASTER's evolution. Existing C# users can keep running the last 2.6.x release but should plan a move.
statusNote: Microsoft marks the repo as no longer actively maintained (last release 2.6.5, May 2024) and recommends Garnet and its Tsavorite engine.

scale.notes: Hybrid log spills beyond memory to local SSD or cloud storage.

strengths: Very high throughput for point reads and in-place updates
Datasets larger than memory via a hybrid in-memory/on-disk log
FASTER Log provides a fast persistent log with low-latency commits
weaknesses: No longer actively maintained by Microsoft
No range scans over keys; designed for point operations
useCases: Existing .NET state stores pending migration to Garnet/Tsavorite
